purpose: Generate the body-only component as a true upper-left three-quarter back view, not a straight rear silhouette.
shapeStrategy: Use a 15–25 degree upper-left three-quarter back turn. Shift the top of the core 4–6 px screen-left of the foot center; expose a small inner plane on the screen-left ear while the screen-right ear recedes; use asymmetric side contour and value planes to make the turn readable.
colorStrategy: Preserve approved poet colors; slightly lighter screen-left near plane and darker screen-right receding plane, without gradients.
materialStrategy: Bold outline, flat values, low detail.
allowedVariation: native three-quarter back re-projection of ears, side planes and tail
